title: Gasoline explained
licence_note: US federal government work (EIA Energy Explained). Checked 2026-11-16: most US pump gasoline contains about 10% fuel ethanol; grades and formulations.

title: Diesel fuel explained
licence_note: US federal government work (EIA Energy Explained). Checked 2026-11-16: diesel is distillate fuel oil for compression-ignition engines; on-highway diesel is ultra-low sulfur, 15 ppm or less.

title: Heating oil explained
licence_note: US federal government work (EIA Energy Explained). Checked 2026-11-16: heating oil and diesel are closely related distillates; IRS requires heating oil and other non-highway distillates to be dyed red.

title: Hydrocarbon gas liquids explained (propane and butane)
licence_note: US federal government work (EIA Energy Explained), last updated 2023-12-26. Propane and butane are gases at atmospheric pressure and liquids under higher pressure; stored and transported in pressurized containers.

title: Fuel Recommendations - EU1000, EU2200, EU3000i Handi (Honda Generators)
org: American Honda Motor Co., Honda Power Equipment (manufacturer)
licence_note: Manufacturer web page, copyright American Honda Motor Co. Checked 2026-11-16: fuel deteriorates faster with air and heat; stabilizers will not reconstitute stale fuel and have their own shelf life; no more than 10% ethanol; storage steps by months.

title: OSHA QuickCard: Portable Generator Safety
org: US Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA); copy hosted by eLCOSH (CPWR)
licence_note: US federal government work. Checked 2026-11-16 (eLCOSH copy): never attach a generator directly to a structure's electrical system unless it has a properly installed transfer switch, because of the electrocution risk to utility workers; use undamaged heavy-duty grounded (3-prong) extension cords.

title: Choosing and Using Fire Extinguishers
licence_note: US federal government work, page last reviewed 2023-04-01. PASS steps; classes A, B, C, D, K; the use-it-only-if checklist; young children and older adults should not use extinguishers; label rating meaning (1A = 1.25 gal of water; 10B = 10 sq ft).

title: Smoke Alarms
licence_note: US federal government work, page last reviewed 2026-10-13. Alarms inside and outside each sleeping area and on every level; test monthly; replace the whole alarm 10 years from the manufacture date; ionization vs photoelectric, both or dual-sensor recommended.

title: Generally Accepted Firearms and Ammunition Interchangeability
org: Sporting Arms and Ammunition Manufacturers' Institute (SAAMI)
licence_note: Copyright SAAMI. Read 2026-11-16: use only the ammunition designated by the firearm maker; markings usually on the barrel, sometimes frame or receiver; match the headstamp to the marking; rimfire and some military rounds have no designation on the headstamp, so check the original box; fitting the chamber does not make it safe; table of the few accepted alternates (e.g. 38 Special in a 357 Magnum chamber).

title: OTC Drug Facts Label
licence_note: US federal government work. Explains the Drug Facts panel on over-the-counter medicines (active ingredient and amount per unit, purpose, uses, warnings, directions, other information, inactive ingredients); rule is 21 CFR 201.66.

title: Food Product Dating
org: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS)
licence_note: US federal government work. Explains Best if Used By, Sell-By, Use-By and Freeze-By phrases; dates are about quality, not safety, except infant formula, the only product whose date is federally required.
